items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Ella came to the Tia Juana club where the interviewee performed, but the interviewee does not claim a personal interaction, collaboration, or friendship with Ella, only acknowledging her presence in the same scene.

ctx.x: Let me ask you this about the other big-time jazz vocalists who were coming through in that era – Ella [Fitzgerald] and Billie and Sarah. I know they loved you to a degree, when they heard you.
There was a club called [Café] Tia Juana in Cleveland. That’s where they would come, to the Tia Juana.
